angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 876,582 km at 299.52 pc = 0.04 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 3.3387 +/- 0.0202 mas (same row, RUWE 0.85): 299.52 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.26 +/- 0.04 solar radii from Gomez et al. 2013, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of WASP-75 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2013A&A...559A..36G/abstract): 876,582 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.14 +/- 0.07 solar masses from Gomez et al. 2013, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of WASP-75 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2013A&A...559A..36G/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 6100 +/- 100 K from Gomez et al. 2013, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of WASP-75 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2013A&A...559A..36G/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Gomez et al. 2013, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of WASP-75 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2013A&A...559A..36G/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/wasp-75.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.294, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-75 (pscomppars): spectral type F9, from Gomez et al. 2013 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2013A%26A...559A..36G/abstract)
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, BD-11 5929: main object type PM*, High Proper Motion Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-75 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.07 dex, from Gomez et al. 2013 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2013A%26A...559A..36G/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-75 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.30426, from Barros et al. 2016 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2016A&A...594A.100B/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-75 (pscomppars): age 3.5 Gyr, from Gomez et al. 2013 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2013A%26A...559A..36G/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-75 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 4.3 km/s, from Gomez et al. 2013 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2013A%26A...559A..36G/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
